crossRefs.note: He said, “Don’t come close. Take off your sandals, for the place you are standing on is holy ground.”
The prince of Yahweh’s army said to Joshua, “Take off your sandals, for the place on which you stand is holy.” Joshua…
Guard your steps when you go to God’s house; for to draw near to listen is better than to give the sacrifice of fools…
We heard this voice come out of heaven when we were with him on the holy mountain.

translations.web: The Lord said to him, ‘Take off your sandals, for the place where you stand is holy ground.
translations.bsb: Then the Lord said to him, ‘Take off your sandals, for the place where you are standing is holy ground.
translations.kjv: Then said the Lord to him, Put off thy shoes from thy feet: for the place where thou standest is holy ground.
translations.asv: And the Lord said unto him, Loose the shoes from thy feet: for the place whereon thou standest is holy ground.
